action: Government and diplomatic organisations: have mail server teams read ESET's research on Turla's toolkit and check Exchange servers for its indicators. SRI's release gives no technical guidance. Others: no action needed.
attack: T1114.002 Email Collection: Remote Email Collection
date_note: SRI release dated November 11; the intrusion itself was detected in December 2025
exec: A state-linked intrusion into government email was contained; the agency's statement confirms ESET's research on the same group.
plain: Romania's intelligence service said it stopped an attack by the Russian Turla group on a government body's email late last year, found no sensitive data taken, and has told EU and NATO partners.

key_findings: SRI's National Cyberint Center detected the attack on a national-level government institution in December 2025 and applied countermeasures and remediation.
The release names the Russian cyber actor APT Turla and says it responds to information that had appeared publicly.
The attackers exploited several systemic vulnerabilities in Microsoft operating systems; no further technical detail is given.
SRI identified no exfiltration of sensitive data and says the affected email service has been remediated.
The case was shared with European intelligence partners and EU and NATO counterparts; investigations into other Russia-linked campaigns continue.
recommendations: The release gives no recommendations for institutions or the public.

summary: Romania's intelligence service SRI said on November 11 that its National Cyberint Center detected, in December 2025, an attack by the Russian actor APT Turla on a national-level government institution and stopped it. The attackers exploited several systemic vulnerabilities in Microsoft operating systems. SRI found no exfiltration of sensitive data and the email service was remediated. The case was shared with EU and NATO counterparts.
title: SRI: Romania's Cyberint centre stopped Turla attack on a national government institution

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Romanian Intelligence Service (SRI) document.
